6: NIKÍTA. Mother! My own mother! I've ruined my life! What have you done with me? Where am I to go? [ Runs out of the hut; Matryóna follows him ]. NAN. Daddy dear, darling, they've smothered it!
5: MATRYÓNA [ whispers ] No! I tell you!
4: NIKÍTA [ stands listening ] Still alive … there … it's whining! Don't you hear?… There!
3: NIKÍTA. Give me more drink! [ Drinks ]. MATRYÓNA. Now go, sonnie. You'll fall asleep now all right.
1: MATRYÓNA [ whispers ] Now then, what is it? Heaven help you! Why won't you get to rest? How can it be alive? All its bones are crushed!
